question: The local communities of merchants were known as ________ in the Vijayanagara empire.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kudirai Chettis.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **local communities **of **merchants** in the Vijayanagara empire were known as **Kudirai Chettis.**
 
• Kudirai Chettis were mainly involved in the **trade of horses.**
 
• They were considered an important part of the** trading community **in the empire.
 
• Kudirai Chettis were known for their** business acumen** and were respected for their **wealth and influence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rachavarus **were the **cultivators **who worked on the lands owned by the Vijayanagara empire.
 
• **Narapattis **were the **military commanders** who were in charge of the armies of the empire.
 
• **Gajapattis** were the **elephant trainers **who were responsible for training and maintaining the war elephants of the empire.
